user.title: UniFi controller
user.description: Use a local UniFi OS account (no Ubiquiti SSO, no 2FA). A view-only admin is sufficient.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the gateway, e.g. 192.168.1.1
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave disabled for the self-signed certificate of the gateway; its fingerprint is then pinned on first connect.

ssh.title: SSH access to the gateway
ssh.description: The magic packet is sent by the gateway ({host}) itself on the VLAN interface of the client. Enable SSH in the UniFi OS console settings and set a password there. The SSH host key is pinned on first connect.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi Wake-on-LAN
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the new password for the UniFi account `{username}` and/or the SSH user `{ssh_username}`. Leave a field empty to keep the stored password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UniFi Wake-on-LAN
reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings. Your selected clients are kept. Leave password fields empty to keep the stored passwords. If the host changes, the new gateway's SSH host key and certificate are pinned.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the gateway, e.g. 192.168.1.1
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave disabled for the self-signed certificate of the gateway; its fingerprint is then pinned on first connect.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the UniFi controller.
error.cannot_connect_ssh: Cannot connect to the gateway via SSH.
error.no_wol_method: No usable tool to send Wake-on-LAN packets was found on the gateway.
error.host_key_mismatch: The gateway's SSH host key has changed. If this is expected, re-trust it in the integration options.
error.certificate_mismatch: The controller's HTTPS certificate has changed. If this is expected, re-trust it in the integration options.

init.title: Wake-on-LAN clients
init.description: Choose the clients that should get a wake button and an online sensor. ● online, ○ offline, 📶 Wi-Fi (Wake-on-LAN rarely works over Wi-Fi), ? not found on the controller.

data.retrust_host_key: Re-read and trust the SSH host key and certificate

data_description.retrust_host_key: Only needed if the gateway's host key or certificate changed (e.g. after a reset or firmware update). You will see the fingerprints before anything is stored.

trust.title: Trust new fingerprints?
trust.description:
**SSH host key (SHA256)**
Stored: `{ssh_old}`
Now: `{ssh_new}`

**HTTPS certificate (SHA256)**
Stored: `{tls_old}`
Now: `{tls_new}`

Only confirm if you expected this change (reset, new gateway, firmware update). An unexpected change can mean that someone is intercepting the connection.

error.cannot_connect_gateway: Cannot reach the gateway (SSH or HTTPS).
error.controller_unavailable: The UniFi controller is currently not reachable. Only the stored clients are listed.

host_key_mismatch.message: The gateway's SSH host key has changed. Open Settings → Repairs to check and trust the new key.

no_entries.message: No UniFi Wake-on-LAN entry is loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several UniFi Wake-on-LAN entries are loaded, please select one.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected config entry is not loaded.

ssh_auth_failed.message: The gateway rejected the SSH credentials. Please re-authenticate the integration.

controller_auth_failed.message: The UniFi controller rejected the credentials.

wake.name: Wake client
wake.description: Sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet from the UniFi gateway on the client's network/VLAN.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: MAC address of the client to wake.

interface.name: Interface
interface.description: Optional gateway interface (e.g. br20). Determined automatically from the client's network if omitted.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several controllers are configured.

wait.name: Wait until online
wait.description: Wait until the controller reports the client as connected. The response then contains `online: true/false`.

fingerprint_changed.title: SSH host key or certificate of {title} changed

confirm.title: Trust the new fingerprints of {title}?
confirm.description:
**SSH host key (SHA256)**
Stored: `{ssh_old}`
Now: `{ssh_new}`

**HTTPS certificate (SHA256)**
Stored: `{tls_old}`
Now: `{tls_new}`

Only confirm if you expected this change (reset, new gateway, firmware update). An unexpected change can mean that someone is intercepting the connection.

abort.cannot_connect_gateway: Cannot reach the gateway (SSH or HTTPS).
abort.entry_removed: The integration entry no longer exists.
